newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 8.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 8.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Tuesday:

* On Monday, Composite Index of key blue chips ended down 12.78 points or 1.19 percent to 1,060.53 on concerns about the region's markets. Morgan Stanley's downgrading of its weighting on Malaysia to seven percent from eight percent also dampened sentiment.
* "Today the market might rebound," said a technical analyst at a local brokerage firm. "It's hit the low-end of the triangle pattern."
* Wall Street ended down 37.32 points to 7,858.49 on Monday.

* Ringgit remained under pressure from fund demand for dollar, but decline limited by continued presence of Bank Negara at 2.5250 a dollar, dealers said. At 1000 GMT on Monday, ringgit was at 2.5240/50 to a dollar.

* Water treatment plant operator Puncak Niaga Holdings to debut on Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange's main board with offer of 67 million new and existing shares at 3.80 ringgit for the retail tranche and 4.50 ringgit for institutions.
